definitions.explanation: The moon phase when the right half is illuminated, occurring about a week after the new moon.

examples.japanese: {今夜|こんや}は{上弦|じょうげん}の{月|つき}だ。
examples.english: Tonight is a first quarter moon.

examples.japanese: {上弦|じょうげん}の{月|つき}は{右半分|みぎはんぶん}が{光|ひか}っている。
examples.english: A first quarter moon has the right half illuminated.

examples.japanese: {上弦|じょうげん}から{満月|まんげつ}まで{約|やく}{一週間|いっしゅうかん}かかる。
examples.english: It takes about one week from first quarter to full moon.

notes:
{上弦|じょうげん} refers to the first quarter moon phase. The name comes from the shape resembling a bow ({弓|ゆみ}) with the string on top ({上|うえ}).

MOON PHASES IN JAPANESE:
- {新月|しんげつ}: new moon
- {上弦|じょうげん}の{月|つき}: first quarter moon
- {満月|まんげつ}: full moon
- {下弦|かげん}の{月|つき}: last quarter moon (left half illuminated)

MEMORY AID:
- {上弦|じょうげん}: String on top → right side lit (first quarter)
- {下弦|かげん}: String on bottom → left side lit (last quarter)

Note: These terms are used in astronomy, traditional calendars, and sometimes weather forecasts.
